title: Blog pull quotes flat: .gamecult-outtake becomes a typeset pull quote hanging into the margin with one orange rule, no box, no tilt
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'Cards: inventory and cuts (map revision 3)'. Ruling: operator-no-cards-except-floats. Line numbers from 410485e; re-read by selector.

Surface: aside.gamecult-outtake on four posts (borrowed-witness-priced-risk, gpt-5-6-sol-wrote-a-50000-word-novella-in-8-hours, love-is-how-the-colossus-wakes, purge-the-heretek-from-our-daemonic-swarm). Rules: 1073-1097 (a 34rem box hanging 14rem into the right margin, tilted 0.35deg, orange border .26, orange left rule .28rem, radius 18px, gradient fill, shadow, italic Ubuntu 300 at 1.08rem), 1099-1106 (a second sky bar as ::before), 1108-1114 (under 1280px: narrower, less hang), 1467-1478 (mobile: full width, no transform, radius 16px, its ::before).

It is text, not a float, so the card goes. What is kept is the editorial device: the quote hangs into the margin, set larger and italic, marked by one orange rule on its left, like the engine's blockquote (base.scss: border-left 3px var(--secondary)). The tilt only read against a box edge and goes with it; the ::before bar is a second rule inside a card and goes.
The ritual essays' blockquote and the dossier notes are other left-ruled asides, handled in their own cuts; this cut is the four posts only.

deletes.note: 1073-1097 .gamecult-outtake: transform (1080), border (1081), border-radius (1083), background (1084-1086, 3 lines), box-shadow (1087-1089, 3 lines) deleted. border-left (1082) stays.
1112: the transform in the max-width 1280px variant deleted; width and margin-right stay.
1467-1478 mobile: transform: none (1471), border-radius (1472) deleted; 1476-1478 the mobile ::before rule deleted whole.

keeps_moves: .gamecult-outtake keeps position, box-sizing, width min(34rem, 44vw), max-width, the margin hang (3.1rem -14rem 3.2rem auto), border-left 0.28rem orange, color, font-family, size, style, weight, letter-spacing, line-height; padding becomes 0.2rem 0 0.2rem 1.4rem.
The 1280px variant keeps width min(32rem, 88%) and margin-right -4rem; mobile keeps max-width 100%, margin 2.2rem 0 2.3rem, font-size 1rem; its padding becomes 0.1rem 0 0.1rem 1.1rem.
The four posts' markup is unchanged.

file_changes.change: outtake: box, tilt and ::before deleted; padding left-only.
mobile outtake: radius, transform none and ::before deleted; padding left-only.

authority_map.owner: custom.scss owns the pull quote's one mark, the orange left rule, and its hang; the post markup owns which paragraph is pulled.
inputs: --secondary (the rule's colour, already a literal orange at .84 in the rule; keep as is)
the article column's width (the hang is relative to it)
outputs: a pull quote on four posts: larger italic text, one orange rule on its left, hanging into the right margin on wide screens, full width on phones
derived_state: the quote's position is derived from the margin hang only; no transform remains
forbidden_writers: no background, border (other than border-left), border-radius, box-shadow, transform or ::before on .gamecult-outtake at any width
no change to the posts, the pills, the masthead or the engine
shared_paths: the same left-rule treatment as the engine's blockquote and the home evidence note; the same Deploy Quartz workflow
authority_map.deletion_line: The box, the tilt and the ::before bar are deleted before the new padding is written.

builds: Deploy Quartz green on the landing commit: gh run list -R GameCult/gamecult-site -w "Deploy Quartz" -L 1

tests.name: /Blog/love-is-how-the-colossus-wakes at 1920, 1280 and 375: the outtake has one orange left rule and no box, tilt or ::before
tests.pins: .gamecult-outtake has border-left 0.28rem orange, no other border, background transparent, border-radius 0, box-shadow none, transform none; getComputedStyle(el, '::before').content is 'none'.

tests.name: at 1920 the outtake's right edge is to the right of the article's content box (the hang survives); at 375 it is inside the viewport (scrollWidth == innerWidth)
tests.pins: the editorial device kept, no overflow on phones.

tests.name: git diff base..head --stat: custom.scss only, net about -22

negative.scope: git diff base..head changed lines and --name-only: no match.

operator: read the Colossus post on a wide screen and say whether the pull quote still earns its hang without the box
